annotations.title: Find haunts in a city or state

description: List haunts in a US state, or in one city of that state, using the same state and city grouping as the ScareMap location pages. Call this when the user names a state or city ("haunted houses in Salem, Massachusetts") and has no coordinates. State accepts a name, a slug or a two-letter code. Results are ordered by review count, then name. If the city is not found, the error lists the cities ScareMap has in that state. To search by distance from a point use scaremap_find_haunts.

category.description: Only this category. Call scaremap_categories for the list.

city.description: City name within the state. Omit to list the whole state.

season.description: halloween = seasonal haunt, year_round = open outside October.

state.description: State name, slug or two-letter code, for example "Massachusetts", "new-york" or "TX".

name: scaremap_find_haunts_in_city

page_url.description: ScareMap location page for this state or city.
